title: [refinementList] sortBy doesn't factor in transformData

comments.body: Hi @razvanh, indeed `sortBy` is applied before `transformData`. I'm not sure whether we should "fix" that because some might rely on this behaviour. I'll sync up with the team.

This problem is not present anymore with [`transformItems`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/refinement-list/js/#widget-param-transformitems), introduced in [2.10.0](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#2100-2018-08-08). This function is applied after `sortBy`.

You can read more on how to migrate to this API in [our InstantSearch.js v3 migration guide](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/upgrade-guides/js/#transformdata-is-replaced-by-transformitems).
